university.title: University
university.preview: From my first lines of code to new discoveries.
university.memory: The first time a tiny project finally worked, I couldn't stop clicking through it. I thought I was pretty good — until I stepped into the real world.
university.story: I started engineering with circuits and electrical calculations. But wait, why wasn't it as fun as writing HTML and CSS? Maybe it was time to give web development a proper try.
highlights: Started with simple HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Connected a database with PHP in class, then built on it for my final-year project.
Interned at a software house (Node.js + Express, Nuxt 3 + TypeScript).
university.takeaway: Time to step into the real world of work.
